description: Translate selections, comments and strings with the HeliLingo app running on this PC.
cfg.target: Language to translate into. **As in HeliLingo** — the app's «Translate to»; text already in that language goes to the app's second language (Russian comments → English).
cfg.engine: Translator to try first: `google`, `yandex`, `bing`, `deepl`, `openrouter`, `offline.opus`, `offline.nllb600`… Empty — HeliLingo's order. Easier: **HeliLingo: Choose translator**.
act.hover: Show the translation in a hover with Replace / Copy / Insert below
act.insertBelow: Insert the translation on a new line below
cfg.asComment: **Insert below** inside a comment keeps the comment marker (`// `, `# `…).
cfg.hover: Show the translation of comments and strings on hover.
cfg.strings: On hover, translate prose strings too, not only comments.
cfg.minLetters: Shortest text (in letters) to translate on hover.
cfg.hoverLangs: Translate on hover only in these files (language ids: `typescript`, `python`…). Empty — everywhere.
cfg.footer: Show the languages and the translator under the hover translation.
cfg.contextMenu: Show HeliLingo commands in the editor's context menu.
cfg.statusBar: Show HeliLingo in the status bar (click: the menu).
cfg.errors: Show a message when HeliLingo isn't running or can't translate.
